text: Die Kalenderintegration ist völlig unbrauchbar. Man kann nicht mit Kalendern synchronisieren, und auf Nachfrage gibt's nur Ausreden: die Objekte in dee App hätten mehr Parameter als Kalenderobjekte z. B. in Google Kalender. Aber das ist kein Grund, nicht wenigstens die Google-Kalender-Objekte vernünftig zu synchronisieren. Zur Zeit kann man nur importieren, und wenn man nach einer Weile neu importiert, hat man alles doppelt. Unbrauchbar.

[A] Tasks under a scheduled activity have to be marked completed separately from activity time log. I believe, once time log is completed, app can ask about if linked tasks have been completed (Just like how deleting activity deletes related tasks). Otherwise we end up with zombie tasks (for both single & repeated schedule). Option to hide tasks under activities or some visual indication that they are under this activity may help I guess .............. [B] Parent category doesn't take into account activities or tasks of its children. Not sure if its intended but my programmer brain seems to work that way :P. Eg: I wanted to make a general activity as 'Morning Routine' (for Home) and have tasks from all sub categories in it. .............. [C] I believe definition of tasks and activities becomes confusing for most people. I keep on thinking that tasks can be sub activities under a scheduled activity. But its not the case in tutorial. This can be powerful for some folks but can be confusing (atleast for me) .............. [D] Not sure why an activity's time type can't be changed after creation. Atleast a switch between time range/time amount should be possible since plans may change (Or when I try to be less lazy and want to commit to a time for workout later on :P) .............. From my explorations, this is the most comprehensive app out there! I was 
actually searching for a pomodoro app and found this app. This also 
rekindled my long lost search for a time planner. It has a lot of 
components I am looking for, but in a new format that I kind of like. We 
need to get used to this layout, but not something that cannot be 
understood in a couple of hours. Few comments. I would like ... (1) to see 
the logging and scheduler in the lowest level available intents / tasks 
rather than activities so I know what I am working on (including checking 
completed the lowest level (intent) and not the task, maybe ask when 
checking completed); (2) to delete specific instances of intents on the 
scheduler itself when needed rather than having to go to the intent each 
time to edit and (3) noticed a bug - if I update something on the 
scheduler, it does not update properly - creates multiple instances (old & 
new). I would love to buy the app with above updates. Also I would prefer 
... (4) to check off on instances if intents as I complete rather than only 
tasks; (5) be able to open the schedule as a calendar in my (office) 
Outlook like Gmail calendar, etc.; and (6) only the tasks (or activities in 
current version) that are 'intend'ed for the current time should be 
highlighted under log and not all the ones planned for the day (they can 
show up there but with less prominence). Ideally, those due to start in the 
next 15/30 minutes can also be highlighted a bit. The other question I have 
is whether I will lose all my data in the app (categories, activities, 
etc.) if I refuse to extend the trail and revert to the free version. And 
therefore hesitate to start the trial.

text: This app is ambitious and needs significant work in English translation to make it usable without going to the Wiki or a combination of lots of both time to mess with the app and previous experience with similar option-rich productivity apps  time.  But, I think there might be something special here, so while I rarely rate or review apps and never subscribe unless totally "sold" on an app, I made an exemption here.  The wiki tutorials clearly show the developers are trying hard to clarify how to use the app. They wrote not one but FIVE variations of the tutorial, each for a different  domains of life. I was so thrilled to see one specifically tailored for how to manage housework, that I decided to subscribe for 3 months, so I could offer feedback and a little financial support. Developers, please prioritize a language overhaul in English. With years as an ESOL teacher with a progressive attitude about English as spoken by non-native speakers, I still struggled to understand the basic terminology essential to the app and after much time had to go to the Wiki for a tutorial.  I should not have to use the Wiki for BASIC clarification. Though he admits the language is unintuitive, Oleksander Abul dissed the comments of a reviewer with a similar complaint by stating there is no need to go to the Wiki if one spends "at least 10 minutes playing around" with it. What about all the people who got frustrated and deleted the app without reviewing? Or people who downloaded it, spent too much time trying to figure it out then back burner it indefinitely?  This is not a game. It is a productivity app. No one should have to spend the minimum of 10 minutes trying to figure out what basic terms mean.  A primary goal of a successful app is to make it as intuitive as possible. No need for whistles and bells until you have a sound wagon to ride in.   This is an app about planning and prioritizing time. Please developers, think about this. Think of the amount of time ultimately gained by prioritizing fixing the "unintuitive language" problem.  Think of your time. Think of all the people potentially downloading your app because they value time.  Looking at your Wiki I see a team willing to commit time and thought to this app. I am sure I am not the only person willing to volunteer to help you make the language more clear so this app can become as good as it deserves to be.
author: A Google user
developer_reply: Thank you very much for your rich and honest review! Yes, we've spent an enormous amount of time trying to make the wording as accurate as possible, but seems like we still haven't succeeded in it. We will really appreciate your suggestions about most important things that should be corrected (just email us).

This app meets the need perfectly. 2. The Activity-Task-subtask layout meets my need for complicated project planning. With this app I can assign time to subtasks and get total time for the project. With this function I can brainstorm tasks, type them in first, and put them in structure later. In short, I think the designer is really thoughtful! A few suggestions on improvement: 1. Would be great to sync with Google calendar. 3. I cannot find a way to remove an intent from logging. But now I have to log  "Sleep" everyday, which is a bit funny. 4.Would be great to allow intent time value in a week or month period, such as study French 5 hours a week. text: This is literally my dream app, and the only reason I have not bought it yet is because I am in-between jobs right now and can't afford it.   This is, without a doubt, the best Organization App I have ever had the pleasure to use. I won't lie, there is a bit of a learning curve to it.  The strength of this app is not as a task manager or an agenda, although it's main function is closely tied to them. It's main function is as an "Intent tracker", meaning that you program your intent for the day, and then you track how long you actually kept that intent on the day.  This is extremely ussefull, as it forces you to face what you are actually doing with your time, and makes you reflect what is really important and what you want to accomplish.  It even has a comparison chart of what your intents are vs. what intents you actually  do.  Of course, as a planner app you still have the common lists and tasks. Unfortunately this app doesn't have subtasks as a default, however you can use subtasks up to three levels to create tasks inside tasks. Another thing is the priority system and filter, which makes it really easy to categorize what is really important
author: A Google user

Jessica, thanks a lot for your understanding feedback! I'm glad that you caught the main thing of the app, and benefit with using it!

text: Diferente y original a las otras aplicaciones, no hay app de planificación que ofrezca tanto en variedad, y recientemente la compre. Hubiera podido seguir perfectamente sin pagar, y no es tanto que valga la pena (pues ya ofrece lo suficiente) como da gusto invertir en una buena aplicación. Para los que quieran una app "intuitiva" o sencilla, tal vez quieran buscar en otra parte, lo que esta bien pues todos tenemos distintas necesidades. Pero si quieres algo integral, echa un vistazo y se curioso. Lo interesante es que TU LA PROGRAMAS para que se adapte a lo que quieras. No solo es un planificador de pendientes. Puedes usarlo para organizar las horas de tu día. Llevar registros de los libros que quieres leer y programarlo, o de tu peso semanal. Recordatorios sobre ser agradecido o frases para motivarte en forma de notificaciones. La forma más visualmente agradable de tener a la vista tus hábitos a construir. Y registrar todo eso en forma del tiempo que gastas en categorías de tu vida. Tienes que tomarte el tiempo para saber cómo funciona, y tal vez ver los tutoriales de su pagina de youtube o facebook, pero una vez que lo dominas, es super práctica y completa. Por supuesto hay cosas que mejorar, pero lo importante es que su desarrollador trabaja constantemente en ello. Recomendaría que hubiera la opción en los filtros del calendario mensual poderse elegir determinada etiqueta.

Comme beaucoup de personnes l'ont dit avant moi, application pas du tout 
intuitive, très mal optimisée. Et la réponse "cette appli n'est pas faite 
pour tout le monde" (réponse pas forcément très pro, je trouve, par 
ailleurs) signifie qu'il faut se casser la tête à comprendre quelque chose 
qui est censé nous faire gagner du temps ? En bref : de bonnes intentions, 
des idées, vraiment, mais une organisation des interfaces à revoir, ou à 
défaut, au moins un petit tutoriel afin de nous expliquer son 
fonctionnement pour que cela soit agréable et rapide d'utilisation. Bonne 
continuation cependant.

developer_reply: Clarisse, your remarks are very true. But fo an indie developer it's quite challenging to do everything in a perfect way all at once. Thanks for understanding!

author: Een Google-gebruiker

Roselien, yes, it's not the simplest app ever. Still, I'm glad you've figured out how you can make it work for you.
Please go to Settings->General->Working day hours (turn it off). This way you avoid measuring a day as 8 hours, as you have for now, your stats will be corrected. Most people plan job tasks only, thus need this option.

text: O aplicativo não é tão intuitivo quanto promete. De fato, ele possui diversas funções, porém, o que parece ser uma vantagem acaba por complicar o uso, demandando tempo do usuário para aprendizado de como utilizar a plataforma. Por fim, enfrentei outras dificuldades, como agendar uma atividade diária que se repita sempre; apesar da criação simples, na hora de concluir a tarefa, o usuário passa por um verdadeiro pesadelo ao ver que todas as atividades derivadas foram marcadas como concluídas em todos os dias do mês e não somente a tarefa daquele dia. Essa deveria ser a principal função do aplicativo, porém, o que deveria ser simples não é. No final, o usuário percebe que seria melhor trocar toda a tecnologia por um simples pedaço de papel colado na cabeceira da cama.
